filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.

Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/)
endpoint. Currently supported filters are:

+ date: the inclusive date interval to scope days to look up. When
  unspecified, default is from the beginning of current month to the end
  of following month.

  Example: `{ "date": { "operator": "<>d", "values": ["2022-05-02","2022-05-26"] } }`
  would return days between May 5 and May 26 2022, inclusive.

+ working: when `true`, returns only the working days. When `false`,
  returns only the non-working days (weekend days and non-working days).
  When unspecified, returns both working and non-working days.

  Example: `{ "working": { "operator": "=", "values": ["t"] } }`
  would exclude non-working days from the response. (operations: list_days, list_non_working_days)

_type.description: Body field _type — enum: NonWorkingDay (operations: create_non_working_day, update_non_working_day, update_week_days, update_week_day)

date.description: Date of the non-working day. (operations: create_non_working_day, delete_non_working_day, get_non_working_day, update_non_working_day, get_day)

name.description: Descriptive name for the non-working day. (operations: create_non_working_day, update_non_working_day)

day.description: The week day from 1 to 7. 1 is Monday. 7 is Sunday. — integer >= 1 (numeric string ok) (operations: get_week_day, update_week_day)

working.description: `true` for a working day. `false` for a weekend day. (operations: update_week_day)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
